Connects to 20+ databases and warehouses
limits: A Java service with its own application database to run and upgrade

free_tier.limits: Software is free; it runs on a server you operate

name: Apache Superset
strengths: Open-source BI with a no-code chart builder, a SQL editor and a semantic layer
Works with nearly any SQL database or engine
limits: Web server, workers, a metadata database and a cache to run; more setup than Metabase

free_tier.limits: Software is free; it runs on a server you operate

name: Power BI
strengths: Microsoft's managed BI service; Pro is included in Microsoft 365 E5
Data stays in the tenant's Fabric home region
limits: Every user who views shared reports needs a Pro or Premium Per User licence unless the workspace is on a capacity

free_tier.limits: Free licence covers personal reports only

name: Google Data Studio
strengths: Google's report and dashboard builder; the self-service tier has no charge for creators or viewers
Native connectors to BigQuery, Cloud SQL and Google Sheets
limits: Admin features and support need the paid Pro subscription

free_tier.limits: Self-service tier at no charge

name: Amazon Quick Sight
strengths: AWS managed BI with per-user pricing from $3 a month per reader
Reads directly from RDS, Redshift, Athena and S3

free_tier.limits: Free trial only
